scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/app.js', fs.readFileSync('src/app.js')); console.log('Build erfolgreich');"
scripts.smoke: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); try { if(fs.existsSync('dist/app.js')) { console.log('Smoke Test Passed'); process.exit(0); } else { process.exit(1); } } catch(e) { process.exit(1); }"
